info.title: Cisco Webex
info.description:
Cisco Webex platform API providing access to meetings, messaging, and collaboration features for Webex-enabled applications.

Authentication: Bearer token — use a Webex bot token or personal access token from developer.webex.com. Pass as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

Source: https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 8 of 10 upstream operations covering admin audit events, organization events, and room/space membership CRUD. Excludes the read-only license-tier reference lookups (GET /licenses, GET /licenses/{licenseId}), which have no write operations and are reference lookups rather than automatable CRUD. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

get.description: List admin audit events in your organization. Several query parameters are available to filter the response.

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: List events in this organization, by ID

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: List events which occurred after a specific date and tim

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: List events which occurred before a specific date and time

parameters.name: actorId
parameters.description: List events performed by this person, by ID

parameters.name: max
parameters.description:
Limit the maximum number of events in the response. The maximum value is 200
Default: 100

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description:
Offset from the first result that you want to fetch.
Default: 0

get.description:
List events in your organization. Several query parameters are available to filter the response.
Long result sets will be split into pages.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: List events with a specific resource type. Possible values: messages, memberships, tabs, rooms, attachmentActions

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: List events with a specific event type. Possible values: created, updated, deleted

parameters.name: actorId
parameters.description: List events performed by this person, by ID.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: List events which occurred after a specific date and time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: List events which occurred before a specific date and time. If unspecified or set to a time in the future, lists events up to the present.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description:
Limit the maximum number of events in the response. The maximum value is 200
Default: 100

get.description:
Shows details for an event, by event ID.
Specify the event ID in the eventId parameter in the URI.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the event.

get.description:
Lists all room memberships. By default, lists memberships for rooms to which the authenticated user belongs.
Use query parameters to filter the response.
Use roomId to list memberships for a room, by ID.
Use either personId or personEmail to filter the results.

parameters.name: roomId
parameters.description: List memberships associated with a room, by ID.

parameters.name: personId
parameters.description:
List memberships associated with a person, by ID. 
The roomId parameter is required when using this parameter.

parameters.name: personEmail
parameters.description:
List memberships associated with a person, by email address. 
The roomId parameter is required when using this parameter.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description:
Limit the maximum number of memberships in the response.
Default: 100

post.description: Add someone to a room by Person ID or email address; optionally making them a moderator.

get.description:
Get details for a membership by ID.
Specify the membership ID in the membershipId URI parameter.

parameters.name: membershipId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the membership.

put.description:
Updates properties for a membership by ID.
Specify the membership ID in the membershipId URI parameter.

parameters.name: membershipId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the membership.

delete.description:
Deletes a membership by ID.
Specify the membership ID in the membershipId URI parameter.
The membership for the last moderator of a Team's General space may not be deleted; promote another user to team moderator first.

parameters.name: membershipId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the membership.

tags.name: Admin Audit Events
tags.description: Admin Audit Events are available to full administrators for certain events performed in Webex Control Hub.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Events are generated when actions take place within Webex Teams, such as when someone creates or deletes a message. Compliance Officers may use the Events API to retrieve events for all users within an organization.

tags.name: Memberships
tags.description:
Memberships represent a person's relationship to a room. Use this API to list members of any room that you're in or create memberships to invite someone to a room. Memberships can also be updated to make someone a moderator or deleted to remove them from the room.

Just like in the Webex Teams app, you must be a member of the room in order to list its memberships or invite people.

https://developer.webex.com/resource-memberships.html
